question: What are Qnami's current main threats? Give short bullet points
answer:
Here are Qnami’s current main threats, summarized in concise bullet points:

• High cost and limited accessibility  
  Quantum sensors remain expensive—ranging from tens of thousands to over a million dollars—making them less accessible to smaller organizations and limiting broader adoption ([marketresearch.com](https://www.marketresearch.com/Ken-Research-v3771/Quantum-Sensor-42981871/?utm_source=openai)).

• Talent shortage and technical complexity  
  The quantum sensing field suffers from a shortage of skilled professionals and requires specialized R&D and manufacturing capabilities, which can slow development and commercialization ([marketintelo.com](https://marketintelo.com/report/quantum-sensor-market?utm_source=openai)).

• Regulatory fragmentation and compliance burden  
  Qnami must navigate diverse regulatory regimes across regions. For example, maintaining three distinct sensor architectures to meet US, EU, and Asian requirements increases complexity and cost ([pmarketresearch.com](https://pmarketresearch.com/auto/quantum-pressure-sensor-market/?utm_source=openai)).

• Intense competition from established and emerging players  
  The market includes major players like IBM, Honeywell, Google, and Muquans, as well as agile startups. Qnami must continuously innovate to maintain its competitive edge ([marketresearchfuture.com](https://www.marketresearchfuture.com/reports/quantum-sensors-market/market-analysis?utm_source=openai)).

• Limited market awareness and adoption barriers  
  Many potential users remain unfamiliar with quantum sensor capabilities, leading to hesitance in adoption and slower market penetration ([marketresearch.com](https://www.marketresearch.com/Ken-Research-v3771/Quantum-Sensor-42981871/?utm_source=openai)).

• Integration and standardization challenges  
  Integrating quantum sensors into existing systems is complex, and the lack of standardized protocols further complicates deployment and interoperability ([marketintelo.com](https://marketintelo.com/report/quantum-sensor-market?utm_source=openai)).
